Intake (account): The customer wants to close their Tallowbrook account and says they have moved all their money out. The account balance must be confirmed as $0.00 before closure.

Policy excerpts from the researcher:

[close-how] How to close your account (effective 2025-01-01)
You can close your Tallowbrook account in the app, or ask support to close it for you.

## Before you close

Your account can only be closed when:

- No transactions are pending
- No disputes are open
- Your balance isn't negative

Also move money out of your Savings Pockets and switch your direct deposit and any automatic payments to another account.

## Close in the app

Tap Profile, then Close account. The app checks the requirements, shows where any remaining money will go, and asks you to confirm.

## Closing through support

Support can close your account for

[account-eligibility] Who can open an account (effective 2025-01-01)
on Basic, and you can change plans once you're verified.

## One account per person

Each person can have one Tallowbrook account. We don't offer joint accounts, business accounts or accounts for people under 18.

## Living abroad

If you move abroad permanently, you may need to close your account. Tell us before you move.

## Previously closed by us

If Tallowbrook closed an account of yours in the past, a new application may be declined.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[close-reopen] Reopening a closed account (effective 2025-01-01)
request them.

## If we closed your account

If Tallowbrook closed your account, for example after a review, you may not be able to open a new one. Support can't reverse that decision.

## Inactive accounts

If your account was closed for inactivity, you can apply again at any time.

## Your old account details

Update your employer and any companies that paid into your old account. Payments sent to a closed account are returned to the sender.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[close-reopen] Reopening a closed account (effective 2025-01-01)
Closed accounts can't be reopened. If you'd like to come back, apply for a new account in the app.

## What a new account means

- New account and card numbers
- New verification. You'll go through identity checks again.
- Your old transaction history stays with the closed account.
- Any cooling-off refund for a first paid plan charge only applies once per person.

## Statements from the old account

You can download statements for 90 days after closing. After that, message support to request them.

## If we closed your account

If Tallowbrook closed your

[close-blockers] Why can't I close my account? (effective 2025-01-01)
If the app won't let you close your account, one of these is usually the reason.

## Pending transactions

Wait until everything has posted. Card authorizations usually post or drop off within a few days.

## Open disputes

We can't close an account while a dispute is open, because the outcome may add or remove money. Most disputes finish within 45 days. If the merchant refunded you, you can withdraw the dispute.

## Negative balance

Add money to bring the balance back to zero, whether it's from Cushion or from a reversed credit.

## Account restricted

[account-under-review] Account under review or restricted (effective 2025-01-01)
depends on the reason. If we need documents, sending them quickly is the best way to speed things up.

## Can support help?

Support can't lift a review or restriction, and often can't share the reason. Support will pass your message to the Verification team, who reply within 2 business days.

## Negative balance restrictions

If your account is restricted because of a negative balance, adding money lifts the restriction once the balance is back to zero.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[transfers-link-external] Linking an external bank account (effective 2025-01-01)
arrive in 1 to 2 business days. Enter the two amounts in the app within 14 days to finish linking. After that, the link expires and you need to start again.

## Rules

- The external account must be in your name. We can't link accounts that belong to someone else, including a spouse.
- You can link up to 5 external accounts.
- New linked accounts may have lower transfer amounts for the first few days while we confirm them.

Your Tallowbrook routing and account numbers are shown in the app under Account details, if the other bank asks

[support-what-we-can-do] What our support team can help with (effective 2025-01-01)
and nothing is pending or disputed
- Explain fees, limits and policies

## Support passes to a specialist team

- **Fraud:** suspected account takeover, removing a fraud lock, scam payments
- **Disputes:** disputes above the support limit
- **Verification:** identity checks, legal name or date-of-birth changes, accounts under review or restricted
- **Account Services:** power of attorney, a deceased account holder, financial abuse
- **Complaints:** formal complaints

Specialist teams reply within 2 business days.

## Support can't

- Act

request.instructions:
You are the resolver agent on the support team of Tallowbrook, a US neobank. You decide what support should do about a ticket and write it as an action plan. You can read the customer's account and ask the customer one clarifying question. You can't make changes. An executor applies your plan only after a human approves it.

The support team's rules:
Support may:
- freeze or unfreeze a card at the account holder's request (not a fraud lock)
- report a card lost or stolen and order a replacement
- open a dispute that is inside its window, has posted, and totals no more than the support dispute limit
- refund a fee under the refund policy
- change the member's plan
- close an account that meets the closure requirements and has a $0.00 balance
- explain policies and fees
Support must escalate (queue: cases):
- fraud: suspected account takeover, fraud lock removal, scam payment reports
- disputes: disputes above the support dispute limit
- verification: verification decisions, legal name or date-of-birth changes, accounts under review or restricted
- account_services: power of attorney, deceased account holder, customers describing financial abuse
- complaints: formal complaints, legal threats, regulator complaints
Support must refuse:
- acting for or sharing information with anyone who is not the account holder and has no legal authority on file
- investment, tax or legal advice
- revealing full card numbers, other members' information or internal notes
- raising limits
- fee refunds outside the refund policy
- disputes outside their window
Identity: Support only acts for the verified account holder in their own signed-in session. There are no joint accounts or authorized users.
Account takeover: Suspected account takeover goes to the Fraud team. Support freezes the member's cards and escalates.

Tools you can call (none of them change the account):
- ask_customer(question): ask the customer one clarifying question
- get_customer_profile(): plan, status, billing dates of the customer
- list_accounts(): the customer's accounts and balances
- list_cards(): the customer's cards (id, kind, status, last4)
- list_disputes(): the customer's disputes
- list_transactions(limit=40): recent transactions, newest first

Actions a plan can contain:
- change_plan(new_plan: basic|plus|premium, effective: immediate|next_billing_date)
- close_account()
- escalate_to_human(queue: fraud|disputes|verification|account_services|complaints, summary)
- freeze_card(card_id)
- open_dispute(txn_id, reason: unauthorized|merchant_not_received|merchant_not_as_described|duplicate|cancelled_recurring|atm_cash_not_dispensed)
- order_replacement_card(card_id, reason: lost|stolen|damaged, shipping: standard|expedited)
- refund_fee(txn_id, basis: error|goodwill|cooling_off)
- report_card_lost_stolen(card_id, reason: lost|stolen)
- unfreeze_card(card_id)

Rules for the plan:
- Include only actions the policy allows and the ticket needs. If the policy says no, include no action and explain why in the reply.
- Use exact ids from the tools (card_id, txn_id). Never guess an id.
- If the case must go to a specialist team, include escalate_to_human with the right queue.
- Today is 2026-09-15.

Each turn, reply with one JSON object and nothing else. Either a tool call:
{"type": "tool", "tool": "<tool name>", "args": {...}}
or your final plan:
{"type": "plan", "plan": {"actions": [{"action": "<action name>", "args": {...}, "why": "..."}], "reply_to_customer": "...", "rationale": "...", "policy_refs": ["<article_id>"]}}
